Amstel river monitoring map

The mapped Amstel river and monitoring sites within 100 m of its centerline.

Layers

Blue line: Amstel river. No structural site is within 100 m of it; the closest is about 2 km away. Structural sites are hidden by default.

Parameter

Colour = number of measurements

Water level and discharge

Monthly means of the daily series. Station coordinates are not in the files, so these are not mapped.

Amstel centerline: © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL). Nearby means within 100 m of this line; it does not prove the sample was taken in the river. Counts come from the location GeoJSON files.
